messages:
alex_chen: Quick follow-up from RFC: propose a "micro-quarantine" path for short, noisy abuse spikes. Objective: mitigate loud tenants fast while minimizing false positives. Basic idea: short scoring window, soft reduction (delay/concurrency cap) -> escalate to hard quota if sustained.

maria_garcia: Sounds useful. Can you outline the flow and where it plugs into our stack?

samir_k: Flow sketch: ingress proxy -> scoring service (edge sidecar or central) -> if score > soft_threshold -> apply soft_quarantine (attach X-Quarantine-Delay, reduce concurrency) and emit telemetry -> if still high after decay window -> hard_shed (reject or apply strict quota). Scoring uses 10s sliding window + burst_multiplier.

pat_tyson: Big convo: implement scoring as sidecar (per-edge low-latency) vs central (global correlation). Sidecar avoids extra hop but complicates config/rollouts. Central allows cross-edge correlation for coordinated abuse.

alex_chen: Tradeoffs: Hosted -> central-first for better global signals. Private deployments -> offer sidecar mode. We'll standardize policy blobs so both modes can share rules.

maria_garcia: Policy surface proposal: per-tenant opaque JSON blob with flat keys: max_inflight, short_window_seconds, score_decay, backoff_ms, burst_multiplier. Expose via admission API and let product opt-in per-tenant.

samir_k: Example policy (flat): {"short_window_seconds": "10", "score_decay": "0.5", "burst_multiplier": "3", "max_inflight": "8", "backoff_ms": "200"}

pat_tyson: How do we coexist with token-based quotas today? Migration is non-trivial.

alex_chen: Migration plan: introduce a "soft_monitor" flag that routes traffic to scoring without enforcing. Collect telemetry 48h per-tenant, evaluate false positives, then enable enforcement. Provide CLI to bulk-toggle the enforcement flag.

maria_garcia: Metrics to track: quarantine_enter_count, avg_quarantine_duration_seconds, false_positive_unblocks, per_tenant_peak_reduction_pct, and p99 latency delta when quarantine active. Also surface traces with quarantine headers.

samir_k: Canary plan: start with 1% traffic across 10 pilot tenants for 24h. Ramp to 10% and ~50 tenants if stable. Rollback triggers: error_rate +1% absolute or p99 latency regression >15%.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary started (id=canary-mq-001) on canary-hosts-3 for 10 pilot tenants. Watching metrics: canary.quarantine.enter, canary.latency.p99.

samir_k: Edge-case: legitimate bursty SDK jobs (bulk imports) may trip the scoring. Add history-based burst tokens and a per-tenant allowlist by route. Prefer queuing/delay over drops. Use header X-Quarantine-Delay: <ms> when delaying.

alex_chen: Add per-request debug headers: X-Quarantine-Score and X-Quarantine-Reason. Log samples at 1% for root-cause and product debugging.

maria_garcia: I'll draft a compact RFC fragment: policy schema, rollout playbook, panic thresholds, and operator runbook for false positives.

pat_tyson: I'll mock dashboards and alerts in Grafana: page on repeated false_positive_unblocks spikes or if quarantine_enter_count rises sharply for low-volume tenants.

samir_k: Need to define signal decay math: score_{t+1} = score_t * decay + events * burst_multiplier. We'll include a doc with examples.

alex_chen: Next: infra/ops sync to decide code placement (central service vs sidecar lib) and ownership. I'll prototype the CLI toggle and a minimal scoring lib tomorrow.

maria_garcia: :thumbsup: good sync. Thanks all.
